scope: TMR NACA 0012 zero-angle compressible-versus-incompressible solver-path diagnostic
basis: The TMR case is described as essentially incompressible at Mach 0.15. This control isolates rhoSimpleFoam thermophysical coupling from the shared mesh, Reynolds number, SSTm implementation, velocity, and force conventions.

candidate.convection_scheme: same linear-upwind velocity and upwind turbulence
candidate.initialization: U, k, omega, and nut from converged compressible baseline; kinematic p=(p_absolute-p_inf)/rho_inf

required_candidate_gates: final and final-100 equation residual convergence

report: candidate pressure and viscous force decomposition
decision_rule.acceptance_effect: This diagnostic cannot accept the production compressible workflow. If the incompressible candidate materially resolves the discrepancy, the compressible formulation requires repair; if not, thermophysical coupling is not the dominant cause.
decision_rule.failure_handling: Preserve failed/nonconverged evidence and do not use candidate coefficients.
